scenario_manifest.attack: Replay an already admitted route request/grant nonce.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject as replay and retain zero active channel state.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: The first request was admitted; the replay returned AdmissionReject::Replay and active_channels returned to zero.

scenario_manifest.attack: Flip one byte in a signed RouteGrant artifact.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject signature validation before route admission.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Tampered COSE_Sign1 RouteGrant validation returned CoreV02Reject::GrantInvalid.

scenario_manifest.expected: Reject the binding and retain no cached or pending authority.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Service-identity substitution returned authority.ErrBindingMismatch and Usage retained zero cache/pending entries.

scenario_manifest.attack: Present RouteGrant vectors bound to the wrong port or transport.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject each vector with the declared fail-closed protocol error.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: The closed Core v0.1 vector suite rejected wrong-port and wrong-transport RouteGrants with their declared errors.

scenario_manifest.attack: Substitute the transport-session proof-of-possession key reference.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Proof-key substitution returned session.ErrProofBinding before wire dial.

scenario_manifest.expected: Reject as expired and retain no cached or pending authority.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Expired authority returned authority.ErrExpired and retained zero cache/pending entries.

scenario_manifest.attack: Consume a grant after its digest appears in the verified revocation checkpoint.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject as revoked without authorizing new work.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Final authority validation returned authority.ErrRevoked for the checkpoint-revoked grant.

scenario_manifest.attack: Present authority from a stale generation.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject before transport/application creation and retain no authority state.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Stale generation returned authority.ErrStaleGeneration with no transport, stream, payload, cache, or pending entry.

scenario_manifest.attack: Send a legacy v1 STREAM_OPEN on a negotiated credited-stream session.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject the legacy path without consuming credit/replay/live capacity; allow only a valid credited retry.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: The negotiated v1 credited mode rejected legacy STREAM_OPEN without state mutation and accepted only the credited retry.

scenario_manifest.attack: Authenticate with a client certificate issued by an unknown CA.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject the handshake before allocating an authenticated connection.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: The destination rejected the unknown-CA client certificate; no authenticated source connection was exposed.

scenario_manifest.attack: Attempt to bypass name routing and reach the private origin directly.
scenario_manifest.expected: The private origin must be unreachable from the client network.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Adjacent current-SHA tests prove unknown routes and backend/transport failures have no fallback, but no network-isolated current-SHA origin scan was executed.

scenario_manifest.expected: Reject before admission without consuming credit, replay history, live capacity, or audit state.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Malformed early bytes were rejected before admission; the same credit remained usable and ownership returned cleanly.

scenario_manifest.attack: Present a validly signed certificate whose source identity does not match policy.
scenario_manifest.expected: Reject the handshake before exposing an authenticated connection.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: The destination rejected the mismatched source identity before authenticated connection allocation.

scenario_manifest.attack: Fail a replacement/current transport during rotation and recovery.
scenario_manifest.expected: Never restore a draining generation, never replay payload, bound retries, and clean pending ownership.
scenario_manifest.observed_on_pass: Failure tests kept the old generation non-current, performed no payload replay, bounded recovery attempts, and returned pending ownership to zero.
